document.name: New York Black Belt Center Corona Taekwondo
document.shortDescription: Weekday and Saturday taekwondo classes in Corona for ages 3-14 at New York Black Belt Center.
document.longDescription:
New York Black Belt Center's official Corona page publishes a detailed class schedule for its location at 104-05 Northern Boulevard in Corona with phone (347) 639-1201. The current schedule shows weekday classes for 3-5 year olds at 3:30-4:00 PM, 6-9 year olds at 4:15-5:00 PM, and 9-12 or 9-14 year olds at 5:00-7:00 PM across Monday through Friday, plus Saturday classes starting at 10:15 AM and 11:00 AM.

Because the same official schedule spans weekday after-school and evening sessions plus weekend morning and afternoon sessions, this listing carries the full set of supported timing tags. The provider page also describes NYBBC Corona as a family taekwondo program with classes for kids, families, and everyone.

Sources: https://nybbc.org/location-corona/ https://nybbc.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/NYBBC_Corona_class_Schedule.pdf https://nybbc.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/nybbc_location_corona__0000_corona-517.jpg
